name: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival
nameVi: Lễ hội pháo hoa quốc tế Đà Nẵng
summary: Ten teams compete over the Han River across six nights, with fireworks bursting above the water and Dragon Bridge in the same view. In 2026 the theme was United Horizons, and the nights ran from 30 May to the finale on 11 July.
when: In 2026: 30 May, 6 June, 13 June, 20 June, 27 June, and 11 July. Next year’s dates and grandstand tickets: check on arrival.
